runtime_inputs: authorization credential and static-development verifier credential are runtime-supplied and never echoed
static-development workspace grants are explicit exact-workspace authority and never inferred from request payloads
runtime interpreter authority is selected explicitly and never inferred
managed health is optional; docker-unix-v1 requires its explicit public configuration file, Docker runtime and provider material mode; managed scopes remain separately admitted
docker-unix-v2 requires dynamic workspace authority and the matching full capability catalogue; assignments and grants remain durable Operations decisions
dynamic workspace authority consumes a retained installer-private policy file; ordinary topology artifacts do not deliver it, and the file contains no live grants or credentials
ingress interpreter authority is selected explicitly and never inferred
gateway probe signing authority is selected explicitly and resolves only its secret reference at dispatch
public DNS resolution uses bounded fresh queries against a trusted process-bootstrap endpoint that is never echoed
store endpoints are runtime-supplied and never echoed by readiness
provider endpoint references map to bounded process-local routes and are never echoed
provider bootstrap credentials are mounted files read only by the provider client and are never recursively resolved through operations
product secret authority is admitted by operations and resolved only at interpreter dispatch
local-development secret maps are explicit fixtures and are not selected by production descriptors

configuration_files.trust: Authorized parent supplies target/runtime and separate static/health public verification keys; no private keys or default trust.
Explicit public Unix policy, managed scope references and reviewed product documents; no credentials or inferred authority. Topology delivery has a separate 262144-byte artifact bound.

installer_private_files.trust: Installer-reviewed private policy bound to the reviewed root plan; not a public artifact, credential or grant.
